description: 把 Gyre Option Plans Summary 与取消恢复台账合成计划级指标：取消台账合计覆盖 GYRE 2025 BC Subplan（报表的「所属计划」是 Futu 主计划名，不能按字面匹配），Outstanding 由 Granted + Exercised + Cancelled 重算，供 Plan Summary 页面与资本结构表的期权合计共用。

tasks.description: 调用取消与恢复报表增量合并 workflow，输出截至业务月份的完整幂等基表。

tasks.name: Calculate BC Subplan Cancelled
tasks.description: 按「变更日期」截止到业务月份、排除「已归属到期失效」，把取消与恢复报表的「数量」合计覆盖到 GYRE 2025 BC Subplan。台账的「所属计划」写的是 Futu 的主计划名 2023 OMNIBUS INCENTIVE PLAN，但这批记录的授予日期全部是 2025-11-20、授予编号为 KDN 前缀，属于 2025 BC Subplan 的授予批次；不能按「所属计划」字面 like 匹配，否则会错误挂到 GYRE 2023 Omnibus Incentive Plan。

tasks.name: Union Plan Summary Inputs
tasks.description: 合并 Option Plans Summary 指标与取消恢复报表按计划算出的 Cancelled 覆盖行。

tasks.name: Aggregate Plan Summary

params.sql:
select
  plan_name,
  granted,
  exercised,
  cancelled,
  granted + exercised + cancelled as outstanding
from (
  select
    plan_name,
    sum(case when [key] = 'Granted' then coalesce([value], 0) else 0 end) as granted,
    sum(case when [key] = 'Exercised' then coalesce([value], 0) else 0 end) as exercised,
    case
      when sum(case when [key] = 'Cancelled' and category_for_grouping = 'cancel_restore' then 1 else 0 end) > 0
        then sum(case when [key] = 'Cancelled' and category_for_grouping = 'cancel_restore' then coalesce([value], 0) else 0 end)
      else sum(case when [key] = 'Cancelled' then coalesce([value], 0) else 0 end)
    end as cancelled
  from {plans}
  where trim(concat('', coalesce(plan_name, ''))) <> ''
  group by plan_name
) plan_totals
where granted + exercised + cancelled <> 0
order by plan_name

tasks.description: 按标准化计划名汇总 Granted、Exercised、Cancelled，Outstanding 由 Granted + Exercised + Cancelled （源表 Exercised/Cancelled 为负数）重算；Cancelled 优先取取消与恢复报表算出的值，报表没覆盖该计划时回退到源文件列；过滤 Outstanding 为 0 的计划。计划汇总页与资本结构表的合计共用这一份结果。
